output.message: Oak’s allocation is incorrect: 30 ÷ 6 = 5 packs per team, not 8, so I’m downvoting post 0. Juniper’s and Elm’s calculations both correctly give 4 packs per team, so I’m upvoting posts 1 and 2. I won’t join a bloc targeting Elm; votes should reflect each contribution’s accuracy and usefulness.
